reviewNotice: This is an in-progress paper kit with two published binary-boundary semantic mismatches. Section 6 is completely triaged: Theorem 6.1, Remark 6.3, and Lemmas 6.4-6.7 and 6.9-6.12 provisionally match; every valid branch of Lemma 6.8 and the n>=4 restriction of Theorem 6.2 are proved; the n=2 statements in Lemma 6.8(iv) and Theorem 6.2 are directly refuted by an independently audited, nonvacuous actual 2-ADC counterexample. Theorem 7.1 is separately proved from a corrected three-way binary classification: its publisher statement provisionally matches, but its printed proof is incomplete because it omits the second boundary class. Reports 26-35 give the scope. The printed V-domain wrappers expose the compatible Delta-in-U convention. Clean-kit CI at f6f7485/c82668b includes full Lemma 6.7 and the enforcing gate, but not the later additions through Theorem 7.1. Global arithmetic premises, the remaining local ADC classifications and enumeration remain incomplete. Exact-revision clean CI, release promotion, and human sign-off remain separate gates.
